item.title: 18-year-old dead after Hammond drive-by shooting
item.description: A drive-by shooting in Hammond left an 18-year-old dead Sunday.

item.title: East Baton Rouge Council on Aging reacts to proposed bill requiring monthly audits
item.description: The EBR Council on Aging is holding town hall meetings to address concerns about a proposed bill that would require them to report bank statements to the legislative auditor monthly, while the CEO of EBRCOA is emphasizing their independent operations and existing accountability measures.

item.title: Mount Zion Church in Baton Rouge gets major renovation boost
item.description: Mount Zion First Baptist Church, the oldest Black church in Baton Rouge, is undergoing millions of dollars in renovations to preserve its nearly 200-year history.

item.title: Congresswoman Julia Letlow offers help to Louisiana residents in Mexico amid cartel violence
item.description: Congresswoman Julia Letlow advises Louisianans in Mexico to heed a U.S. Department of State travel alert due to ongoing violence in several Mexican states.

item.title: Our Lady of the Lake Children's Hospital patient gets key to the city of Addis
item.description: Our Lady of the Lake Children's Hospital hosted a celebration Monday for patient Jensen LeBlanc, who was named one of 20 Children's Miracle Network Champions nationwide.

item.title: Gum Swamp Road shuts down after Livingston Parish woods fire flares up
item.description: A woods fire in Livingston Parish that has already burned an estimated 200-plus acres flared back up Monday afternoon, forcing Gum Swamp Road to shut down.

item.title: Louisiana lawmakers to debate governor term limit changes
item.description: Voters could see a proposed constitutional amendment related to governor term limits if approved by lawmakers during the legislative session.
